mode.description: Lossless recompresses streams and object streams; lossy additionally optimizes eligible images with JPEG.

jpegQuality.description: JPEG quality (0-100, default 80) when mode is lossy; rejected in lossless mode.

compressionLevel.description: Descent floor for image resampling: 1 keeps lossless structure only, 2 allows down to ~200dpi at high JPEG quality, 3 allows down to ~120dpi with stronger encoding. Alone it pins that rung; with maxOutputBytes it is the deepest rung the ladder may reach.

maxOutputBytes.description: Publish compressed output at or below this byte ceiling. Implies lossy mode; the ladder descends DPI/quality rungs toward compressionLevel's floor until the target is met.

onTargetMiss.description: When output cannot reach maxOutputBytes: bestEffort publishes the smallest achieved bytes with targetMet false and a SIZE_TARGET_UNMET warning; error fails SIZE_TARGET_UNMET (422) without publishing.

allowLargerOutput.description: Keep compressed bytes even when not smaller. Otherwise publish the validated original bytes and report outputSource original.

path.description: Relative regular-file path inside a configured workspace root; URLs, traversal and symlink escape forbidden.

techniques.description: Compression passes applied to the published candidate: flate-recompress, object-streams, resource-drop, jpeg-recompress, image-downsample; empty when original bytes were published.

targetBytes.description: Echo of the requested maxOutputBytes; present only when the request set it.

targetMet.description: Whether published bytes are at or below maxOutputBytes; present only when the request set it.

path.description: Relative regular-file path inside a configured workspace root; URLs, traversal and symlink escape forbidden.

annotationCount.description: Number of entries in this page's Annots array.

hasMetadata.description: Info dictionary or catalog XMP metadata exists.

preservationEvidence.description: Optional backend comparison hashes for complete metadata, outline structure and attachment content; absent means not verified.

bookmarks.description: Canonical JSON outline structure with 1-based destination positions for selected-page comparison.

operationId.description: Requested operation ID; unknown when parsing did not resolve an operation.

ContentEngine.description: Registered engine ID. When omitted, use the first configured engine for this capability. No fallback on errors.

pages.description: Strictly increasing 1-based page numbers within source bounds.

TextBounds.description: Axis-aligned bounds in unrotated PDF default user space (x right, y up), without rebasing to the crop box. Left <= right and bottom <= top.

text.description: Plain text in engine reading order. Empty if no embedded text is found.

spans.description: Positioned text runs in engine reading order. The engine determines run segmentation and can insert whitespace into page text.

pages.description: Exactly one result per requested page, in request order.

path.description: Relative regular-file path inside a configured workspace root; URLs, traversal and symlink escape forbidden.

Preserve.description: False (default) requests best effort with omission reporting. True requires full preservation when present, or PRESERVATION_UNMET before publication. Primary document information is retained where qpdf supports it; secondary merge document information may be omitted.

x-anpdf-status: development 0.3.0 contract; qpdf 12.x >=12.4.2 required; only 12.4.2 qualified; strict mode requires exact; PDFium is the default text/render engine
